title: LogChirpy - Ornithological Archival App
description: LogChirpy is a mobile application for bird identification and observation logging. It combines multi-modal machine learning — BirdNET-based audio classification and MobileNet image recognition — with a 25,000+ species database derived from the Clements taxonomy. The app supports ornithological field work through photo storage, GPS-tagged sightings, species lookup (BirDex), and multilingual UI. Built with React Native, Expo, TensorFlow Lite, and Firebase.
